name: tvlens-promo
description: TVLens — teaser débat 34 s et présentation 64 s, 1080p

scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts TVLens out/tvlens-promo-1080p.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --concurrency=2
scripts.review: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts TVLens out/review --frames=120,300,440,620,825,1010,1160,1370,1650,1830 --image-format=png --concurrency=2
scripts.render:teaser: npm run assets:teaser && remotion render src/index.ts TVLens-Teaser out/tvlens-teaser-34s.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --concurrency=1
